title: CoreVerse
description: CoreVerse is a modern, modular Essentials-style server core plugin with homes, economy, teleport, and admin tools. It is designed to be lightweight, customizable, and fully configurable through a module system.
body:
⚡ CoreVerse Modern modular server core plugin built for powerful and flexible Minecraft servers.
⸻ ✨ Features * 🏠 Advanced homes system with GUI selector * 💰 Full economy system with balance, pay, and leaderboards * ⚔️ Teleport system (TPA, spawn, back, cooldowns) * 🎒 Inventory utilities (invsee, ender chest, item tools) * 🧍 Social system (messages, reply, ignore, staff spy) * 🛠️ Admin tools (vanish, fly, kick, ban, mute, heal) * 📊 Player statistics tracking (kills, deaths, playtime, KDR) * 🧩 Fully modular system – enable or disable features * ⚙️ Highly configurable and optimized * 🚀 Designed for modern Paper servers ⸻ 📦 Commands Command Description /core reload Reload configuration /home Teleport to a home /sethome Set a home location /balance Check your money /pay Send money /tpa Send teleport request /spawn Teleport to spawn /back Return to previous location /vanish Toggle invisibility ⸻ 🔑 Permissions Permission Description coreverse.admin Full plugin access coreverse.economy Economy features coreverse.home Home system usage coreverse.teleport Teleport system usage coreverse.staff Staff tools access ⸻ 📋 Compatibility * ✅ Paper / Spigot * ✅ Java 17+ ⸻ ❤️ Why CoreVerse? CoreVerse is designed to unify essential server systems into one clean, modular, and high-performance plugin. It gives server owners full control, flexibility, and scalability without unnecessary bloat.
